name: Forwarded DDR and per-lane byte/bit rates
model: R_lane=8*f_byte=2*f_DDR; aggregate=N*R_lane; RGB888 payload pixel throughput=N*R_lane/24
qualification: f_b explicitly means per-lane bit rate; RF fc and receiver Fs do not determine it.

name: RGB888 component-to-lane cycle
model: For N lanes mapping period P=3/gcd(3,N) byte ticks; N=4 means12aggregatebytes/4pixels/3ticks; f_map=f_byte/P.
qualification: Mapping repetition is not arbitrary pixel waveform repetition; equal RGB components can shorten waveform period.

name: Parallel data-lane SoT
qualification: One PHY sync per lane per HS entry; multiple DSI packets may follow one SoT. Not round-robin distribution of a single B8.

name: Fixed EoTp
qualification: May be disabled; VC fixed0; bytes distributed over lanes, not replicated; physical EoT is different.

name: RGB888 video header
model: DI=(VC<<6)|0x3E; WC=3W for exactly W pixels in a single packet; ECC from preceding24headerbits
qualification: VC=0 examples; device mode, WC, ROI, packetization unknown; payload CRC is data dependent.

name: DCS write header plus command
model: DT0x39; payload begins with DCS0x2C or0x3C; WC=1+3W for one command plus W RGB888 pixels
qualification: Command field is not data type. Actual update chunk size and selected pixel format must match.

name: H/V synchronization and blanking headers

evidence.locator: section8.8.1 PDF62-63; sections8.8.11-12 PDF67; section8.11 PDF87-91

qualification: Occurrence varies by video mode; short data bytes not invariably zero; null/blanking payload may be arbitrary.

name: Concatenated packet lane-phase families
model: a_next=(a+packet_bytes) modN; identical-length packet start-lane cycle=N/gcd(N,packet_bytes). Video length3W+6, DCS one-command length3W+7.
qualification: Requires one continuous HS transmission and accounted intervening bytes; HS restart resets offset. Does not imply an observed f_h/2 or f_h/4 is this source.

name: Band-limited known-packet matched subspace
model: Construct lane-distributed bit/edge waveforms, pass through subband/receiver model, fit a constrained complex subspace; calibrate with known-screen events.
qualification: Same SoT alone cannot resolve individual lane channels. Unknown band responses prevent absolute cross-band RF phase recovery from header bytes alone.

name: Event CFO and delay ambiguity
model: Event phase increment=2*pi*delta_f*T mod2pi; CFO ambiguous modulo1/T. Repeated event delay ambiguous by event periods.
qualification: Use within-burst information, distinct event intervals, overlap phase slopes and independent payload validation.
